request.raw_text: Add chamfer to main/biggest cylindrical section of Heatbreak body/component. The chamfer should be same size as present on top of the part, but should be added to the lower edge of the cylinder. This should allow easier insertion of the part during assembly.
reference_geometry_words: main/biggest cylindrical section of Heatbreak body/component
parameter_words: same size as present on top of the part
functional_intention_words: allow easier insertion of the part during assembly

aim.primary_aim: Provide the lower edge of the Heatbreak's main cylindrical section with a chamfer matching the existing top chamfer to facilitate assembly insertion.

functional_design_intentions.name: Easier assembly insertion
functional_design_intentions.description: The lower-edge chamfer should make the Heatbreak easier to insert during assembly.

targets_to_change.reference_geometry: lower edge of the main/biggest cylindrical section of the Heatbreak body/component

required_relationships.reference: lower edge of the main/biggest cylindrical section
existing chamfer at the top of the part

targets_to_preserve.reference_geometry: existing chamfer at the top of the Heatbreak
targets_to_preserve.preservation_rule: Preserve the existing top chamfer as the unchanged size reference for the new lower chamfer.

targets_to_preserve.reference_geometry: all non-targeted geometry of the Heatbreak body/component
targets_to_preserve.preservation_rule: Preserve all geometry not required to provide the requested lower-edge chamfer.

functions.name: Assembly insertion aid
functions.description: The lower-edge chamfer facilitates insertion of the Heatbreak during assembly.

behaviors.name: Guided entry
behaviors.description: The chamfered lower edge provides a lead-in that permits easier entry of the Heatbreak into its mating assembly.

validation_criteria.description: A chamfer is present on the lower edge of the main/biggest cylindrical section of the Heatbreak.
The lower-edge chamfer is the same size as the existing chamfer at the top of the part.
The lower-edge chamfer facilitates insertion of the Heatbreak during assembly.
The lower edge acts as a lead-in during insertion rather than remaining an unchamfered cylinder edge.
The existing top chamfer remains unchanged and continues to define the required chamfer size.
